description.value: Cafe & Life Co. is a community-focused café founded during the COVID-19 pandemic with the explicit goal of reconnecting the local neighbourhood through great coffee and a warm, welcoming space. The Vancouver location on West 7th Avenue offers specialty lattes, freshly baked pastries, and elevated brunch dishes ranging from smoked salmon benny to romesco roast chicken. The café recently completed a soft reopening at this address, making it a cozy neighbourhood stop in a residential, cyclist-friendly part of the city.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 71m; rack at 79m; stands (16 spaces, covered) at 86m; rack at 87m. Total: 16 spaces.

The OSM phone (+1-236-235-0136) matches the website's Richmond location phone, not the Vancouver-specific number (+1 (236) 997-0831) listed on the contact/locations page — flagged as a concern and corrected in output. No website content or OSM tags address bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most other amenities; takeout is confirmed by 'Order Now' CTAs and Uber Eats listings, and the menu contains identifiable vegetarian items.

Website header/top-of-page also displays a third number (+1 (604) 336-9888) as a general contact; its relationship to the two location-specific numbers is unclear.
Vancouver location described as a 'soft opening' on the website, indicating it may have been closed and recently reopened — current status appears active but worth monitoring.
